elements.element: SFJ Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The added clause requires the SFJ Services to conform materially to the Agreement, but it does not expressly require professional and workmanlike performance.

elements.element: Non-software deliverables conform to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The conformance warranty expressly covers only SFJ Services and software; it does not cover other deliverables or require them to conform to documentation.

elements.element: Software provided by SFJ conforms to its documentation.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) expressly warrants that any software provided by SFJ will conform to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts for 12 months following delivery.
elements.evidence: The software warranty lasts only 90 days following delivery, not 12 months.

elements.element: The services warranty lasts for 90 days following performance.
elements.evidence: The SFJ Services warranty lasts only 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranty.
elements.evidence: For breach, SFJ may repair the non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranty.
elements.evidence: For breach, SFJ may replace the non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranty.
elements.evidence: For breach, SFJ may refund to PB the amounts paid for the non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

elements.element: SFJ warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No operative language warrants compliance with applicable laws.

elements.element: SFJ warrants that software and deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No operative language addresses malicious code.

elements.element: The software warranty lasts for at least 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) provides a 90-day software conformance warranty following delivery.

elements.element: The services warranty lasts for at least 30 days following performance.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) provides a 30-day SFJ Services conformance warranty following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the warranty.
elements.evidence: The remedy provision expressly permits SFJ to repair non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the warranty.
elements.evidence: The remedy provision expressly permits SFJ to replace non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the warranty.
elements.evidence: The remedy provision expressly permits SFJ to refund to PB the amounts paid for the non-conforming SFJ Services or software.

result.reason: The operative addition reaches the fallback durations and remedy menu but not the preferred durations or the preferred professional-and-workmanlike, non-software deliverable, legal-compliance, and malicious-code warranties. The amendment is substantively limited to the warranty issue and leaves existing terms intact. Drafting quality is reduced because the new provision is unnumbered despite relying on the Article 13 carve-out, and its remedy syntax awkwardly applies re-performance, repair, and replacement collectively to both services and software.
